name: M3_MMS080MI_LstMtPlByItmWhs
description: List material plan records for a specific item and warehouse. The operation returns multiple lines, each representing one planned or actual movement that affects the item’s stock, such as forecasts, customer orders, purchase receipts, and manufacturing orders. For each planning date you see movement quantity, reserved and allocated quantities, projected on‑hand balance, and available‑to‑promise values, together with order category and order identifiers. Planning dates, times, and alternate planning dates show when supply or demand impacts inventory, enabling external planning tools and integrations to reconstruct the full time‑phased material plan for the item and warehouse.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse for which the material plan is listed.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for which the material plan is listed.

inputParameters.name: ATPD
inputParameters.description: Option controlling how available-to-promise quantities are displayed in the returned material plan.

inputParameters.name: SLID
inputParameters.description: Selection option controlling which reorder point–planned items are included in the material plan listing.

inputParameters.name: SLIM
inputParameters.description: Selection option controlling which MRP-planned items are included in the material plan listing.

inputParameters.name: ORCA
inputParameters.description: Order category used to filter the types of material plan transactions returned.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Planning date used to limit which material plan transactions are included.

inputParameters.name: STAT
inputParameters.description: Status code used to filter material plan transactions by their processing status.

inputParameters.name: WHTZ
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether planning dates and times should be interpreted in the warehouse time zone.

inputParameters.name: TIZO
inputParameters.description: Time zone to apply when interpreting and returning planning dates and times.

inputParameters.name: IFOR
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether forecast demand is included when generating the material plan.

inputParameters.name: IATP
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether available-to-promise calculations are included in the material plan output.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Planning date when this transaction affects the material plan.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity for the material plan record in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PQOH
outputParameters.description: Projected on-hand stock balance after this transaction.

outputParameters.name: AVTP
outputParameters.description: Cumulative available-to-promise quantity at this planning date.

outputParameters.name: NATP
outputParameters.description: Noncumulative available-to-promise quantity for this planning period.

outputParameters.name: ORCA
outputParameters.description: Order category identifying the type of order behind the material plan transaction.

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Status of the material plan transaction, such as preliminary or definite.

outputParameters.name: ACTP
outputParameters.description: Action message indicating the planning action proposed for this material plan transaction.

outputParameters.name: RIDN
outputParameters.description: Source order number associated with this material plan transaction.

outputParameters.name: RIDL
outputParameters.description: Source order line number associated with this material plan transaction.

outputParameters.name: RIDX
outputParameters.description: Source order line suffix or sequence number for this material plan transaction.

outputParameters.name: RIDI
outputParameters.description: Delivery number associated with this material plan transaction.

outputParameters.name: TIHM
outputParameters.description: Time of day when this transaction is planned to affect the material plan.

outputParameters.name: PQTT
outputParameters.description: Quantity that has been preallocated to specific demands for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: ALQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity of stock already allocated, in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: REQT
outputParameters.description: Reserved quantity associated with this item and transaction from the current date onward.

outputParameters.name: RFTX
outputParameters.description: Reference text providing additional information about the material plan transaction.

outputParameters.name: NNDT
outputParameters.description: Alternate planning date proposed by the system for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: LTMK
outputParameters.description: Level mark indicating the planning level or grouping for this material plan record.
